name: provider-switch
description: Switch Claude Code between Claude and an OpenAI-compatible proxy (e.g. IETI Agents Proxy) from a pane

proxyUrl.title: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible proxy, e.g. https://agents.example.com ("/v1" is added if missing). Can also be set from the pane.

apiKey.title: Proxy API key
apiKey.description: API key for the proxy (ieti_sk_...). Kept in secure storage. A key typed in the pane takes precedence.
